messages:
kim-cs: Heads up 1:30 UTC were seeing bulk import failures for a subset of tenants. Clients see immediate 429s and some webhooks are delayed. Affected list in the sheet. Need quick status note.
jared-eng: Investigating now. Initial signal: shared token budget exhaustion + synchronous import bursts. Implementing per-tenant rate-limits + offload to background queue. ETA ~20-30m.
nora-cs: Can we reassure customers and offer a hands-on import session? Prioritize pilot/renewal accounts.
kim-cs: Draft to send in 15m: "Hi, were aware of errors affecting bulk onboarding/imports (some jobs returning \"rate limit\"). Engineers are rolling a mitigation now; expected recovery in 2010 minutes. Were isolating heavy imports and offering prioritized support sessions. Well follow up with an RCA and account credit where applicable. Reply if you need live help"
lee-ops: Ill start migrating pending imports to a low-concurrency worker and flag verified failures for provisional credits. Billing will finalize later.
jared-eng: Patch at ~40% rollout; route errors down ~65% in early telemetry. Monitoring embedding upstream fallbacks.
kim-cs: Action items: nora-cs to start targeted outreach for top 5 accounts; jared-eng to post final clearance; lee-ops to prepare provisional credits. Ill send the customer note once nora okays it.
pager-bot: Incident INC-2026-28401 created and assigned to eng-oncall (jared-eng).
kim-cs: Thanks all 1 will compile a short exec blurb after clearance.
